name: solidity-delayed-bridge-claims
title: Delayed bridge claim escrow
description: Funded message epochs with publisher delay, cancellable pending roots and replay-protected token releases.
assumptions: Centralized publisher escrow, not a trustless cross-chain bridge. No source-chain proof verification or permissionless fraud challenge. Owner can cancel before activation. Message IDs are globally consumed across batches and must include source-chain uniqueness when constructed externally.
